ULCT.description: Underground Load Combination Type (ULCT). Assigned per element (key = element number); the single flag bUNDERLOADTYPE marks whether the element uses the underground load combination type.

bUNDERLOADTYPE.description: Underground load type flag for the element. true => underground load combination type (EN_ULCT_UNDERGROUND); false => non-underground (EN_ULCT_NONE_UNDERGROUND).
